About DevRev 

 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

 About the role 

 We are looking for ambitious software developers who can bring a fresh perspective to solving challenging problems and build infrastructure that will support AI/ML applications and a delightful user experience. A good grasp of operating systems, distributed systems, databases, and networking concepts and the ability to design for scale, optimized memory usage, and performance are required to be successful in this role. As a software developer at DevRev, you will have the opportunity to build things that truly matter and to work with a thriving global team.

 
  

 What you'll bring 
 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field

 At least 5-7 years of software development experience

 Software development experience coding in C, C++, Java, and/or Golang

 Strong experience with memory and performance optimization

 Experience building and working with API integrations

 Affinity to lead a small team while remaining hands-on in engineering

 Knowledge of and experience with agile development processes

 Creative problem solving

 
 Preferred qualifications:

 
 5+ years of experience programming with two or more of the following languages: C, C++, Java, Golang, or Python

 Experience with implementation and development of microservices-based scalable architecture

 Experience with Cloud development technologies such as AWS Lambda, SQS, Dynamodb, etc.

 Experience with building and operating large scale systems in multi-tenant environments

 





 DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.
